css: .ticker { border-top: 1px solid rgba(20, 22, 19, 0.14); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(20, 22, 19, 0.14); padding-top: 26px; padding-bottom: 26px; overflow: hidden; background-color: #f2ede4; } .ticker-track { display: flex; align-items: center; grid-column-gap: 40px; white-space: nowrap; } .ticker-item { font-family: "Instrument Serif", serif; font-size: 44px; line-height: 1; color: #141613; } .ticker-item.is-italic { font-style: italic; color: #d4502a; } .ticker-dot { width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 999px; background-color: #d4502a; flex: none; } @media screen and (max-width: 767px) { .ticker-item { font-size: 32px; } }
